rationale: User asked to prepare for every command-palette and launcher operation and to classify each as a wezterm-core call vs a GPUI surface, same pattern as lua-config.json. Live files: docs/command-palette.json and docs/launcher.json. Palette items come from wezterm-gui CommandDef (commands.rs), not a hardcoded POC handful. Launcher is a termwiz overlay that also dumps COMMANDS+KEY_ASSIGNMENTS; do not clone that UI. GPUI palette lists the full Windows default catalog with unimplemented rows dimmed. Do not path-dep wezterm-gui; dispatch by catalog id.
